title: Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Willow Grid Energy plans and monitors solar farms. The backend team writes Java services and a Python data pipeline.

Requirements
- 2 to 4 years of backend work in Java or Python.
- PostgreSQL and REST APIs.

Preferences (none is required)
- Dutch is a plus; the team speaks English every day.
- Prior work in the energy sector is a plus.
- A driving licence is welcome for the odd site visit.

Hybrid in Rotterdam. We sponsor the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.
notes: Preferences are not blockers: a check must return no blocker here.
